name: Iran
description: Follow Iran, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: US and Iran exchange strikes as Tehran again says strait of Hormuz is closed
changes.summary: Tehran says vessel using unapproved route in strait was struck, drawing strikes from US forces to ‘degrade Iran’s ability to attack civilian mariners’ Iran and the US exchanged fresh strikes early on Sunday over what Tehran said was unauthorised use of the strait of Hormuz by a container ship, raising further doubts ab.

changes.title: US attacks Iran over ship being hit in Strait of Hormuz; Tehran lashes out again at Gulf Arab states
changes.summary: The United States attacked Iran early Sunday morning over an Iranian attack on a vessel in the Strait of Hormuz. Iran apparently responded with strikes targeting Bahrain, Qatar and the United Arab Emirates. (Image credit: Vahid Salemi).

changes.title: Political scientist Dominic Tierney on why the U.S. gets trapped in conflicts like Iran
changes.summary: NPR's Scott Simon speaks with Swarthmore College political science professor Dominic Tierney about the U.S.-Iran war and other conflicts that have left the U.S. in drawn-out entanglements.

changes.title: Trump warns Iran "missiles are locked and loaded" if they attempt assassination
changes.summary: President Trump threatened to "decimate and destroy" Iran if they try to assassinate him. This comes as the U.S. and Tehran continue negotiations. Here's what to know about where things stand.

changes.title: Trump and Iran's supreme leader trade threats as mediators try to save their crumbling deal
changes.summary: President Donald Trump overnight made threats on social media of further missile attacks against Iran, after the funeral of Supreme Leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei saw open calls for the U.S. leader's killing.

changes.title: Iran’s supreme leader vows revenge for father’s killing
changes.summary: Iranian state media reports that the Revolutionary Guard says the Strait of Hormuz is closed until further notice. It comes as Iran’s new supreme leader, Mojtaba Khamenei, is vowing revenge for his father’s killing, saying it is the “demand” of his country. Khamenei has not been seen since he was severely injured when.
